Di lallantop ka salana adda laut aaya hai. jamega 22, 23 aur 24 navanbar 2024 ko dilli ke mejar dhyan chand neshnal stediyam men. 3 dinon ke lie banie adde ka hissa sirph 499 rupae men. rajistreshan ke lie par die bainar par klik kijie
The Lallantop’s Chunav Yatra has reached Dhanbad district of Jharkhand. Abhishek Tripathi and Vijay Kumar reached the Jharia Coal Mines which falls under Jharia assembly seat. Congress’s Poornima Niraj Singh is the MLA from Jharia. In the coal mines, we saw the fires which have been burning here for almost 100 years. We also spoke to the people living here.
